modal.urlKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current target URL

modal.createStoppedHint: New tasks are saved stopped. Start explicitly after verifying the target to avoid accidental publishing.

actions.legacyEnable: Enable legacy forward (takes effect on the next publisher session)
actions.legacyDisable: Disable legacy forward (does not guarantee immediate termination of an existing Forward)

tasks.note: OUT-PUSH is executed by the managed Push Worker and FFmpeg. RUNNING means the managed process is alive while the local input remains online; it does not prove the remote platform is playing successfully. Stop terminates the local outbound process.
tasks.legacyHint: Legacy tasks remain on SRS Dynamic Forward to avoid double-pushing during upgrades. Configuration changes primarily affect subsequent publisher sessions.
